TP4056 datasheet typical (Ibat=1200/Rprog, 4.2V CV, Iterm=C/10, thermal regulation ~120C, theta_JA~120C/W) - ASSUMPTION, not locally transcribed

notes: Deep-discharge worst case (Vbat~3.0 V, 500 mA) dissipates ~1.0 W. On a 2-layer board without dedicated thermal copper (theta_JA~120 C/W) the die reaches the ~120 C thermal-regulation point at Tamb=40 C, so the TP4056 will fold back the charge current (longer charge time, not damage). Recommendation: Rprog to ~3.0-3.6k (330-400 mA) or add thermal copper/vias under the exposed pad, or accept foldback. theta_JA value is an ASSUMPTION; sensitivity is in the metrics.
